stem:
Kiara grows three similar seedling pots.
Pot R gets sunlight and water every day.
Pot S gets sunlight but no water.
Pot T gets water every day but stays in the dark.

parts.text: Which claim about the pots is best?

options.text: Pot R should grow best because it has both sunlight and adequate water.
Pot R and Pot S should grow equally well because both get sunlight.
Pot T should grow best because water alone is enough for strong growth.
Pot S should grow best because plants need sunlight more than water.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Best growth needs both sunlight and water; missing either reduces growth or can kill the plant.

teacher.key_rationale: Sunlight and water together support best growth; water alone or sunlight alone is not enough.
